planner.question: Defeat every full-input program of the same U at a stronger stage by an exact simultaneous crossing-transcript adversary.
planner.strategy: Separated disjointness selector encoding, eliminate prefix-blind descriptions, splice full-input runs using bounded combined records.
planner.alternative: Audit polynomial solvability of the encoded family and the exact remaining exponent gap.
planner.stop_rule: Do not claim integer exponent two, superpolynomial lower bounds, or transfer of the one-tape clock bound to all SAT algorithms.
literature_leads: Classical crossing sequences and deterministic disjointness fooling-set argument; prior exact U and prefix adversary. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: For n=32m and all sufficiently large m there is a bad satisfiable input at weighted stage 2^s=Theta(L^2/log^2 L), against all descriptions in the same U.
construct.scope: Same explicit selector order, same U, length-weighted clocks and general one-tape interpreter; all descriptions at the chosen stage.
construct.derivation: Encode complementary forbidden sets in separated ternary regions. Record crossings, local time, head and rejected-output certificate for every long program. Count collision of short combined records and splice a satisfiable cross.
unresolved_steps: Prove bad witness existence at integer exponent two and every larger exponent.
candidate_tests: Actual selector geometry, onehot encoding, all small forbidden sets, exhaustive compact machine splice and rejection tests.

alternative.claim: The disjointness/pin family has a fixed polynomial witness finder and cannot witness every polynomial exponent; the near-quadratic budget misses the integer-two target.
alternative.scope: Same explicit selector order, same U, length-weighted clocks and general one-tape interpreter; all descriptions at the chosen stage.
alternative.derivation: Scan the forbidden selectors and pick a surviving index, then reconstruct fixed onehot/copy/pin values. U eventually includes this fixed solver at a polynomial cutoff.
unresolved_steps: A noncircular computational obstruction beyond tape crossing or a universal polynomial cutoff.
candidate_tests: Check concrete witness reconstruction, boundary cases, and exact clock formulas.

objections: Splicing must preserve actual clock, not just crossing states.
